_comment: The PDP-Connect reference operations, served over HTTP by apps/site's sandbox
routes. This is a real, runnable PDPP resource server in this repository today:
the routes under apps/site/src/app/sandbox/v1/ mount the same operations that
packages/reference-operations-sandbox vendors from the reference implementation.
Start it with:  cd apps/site && npx next dev -p 3211
Two things about this target shape the expected result, and neither is a defect
1. It is a PUBLIC DEMO with no authorization. Every route hardcodes
`actor: { kind: 'owner', subject_id: null }` (see the route sources) and reads
no Authorization header. So it cannot enforce a grant, and the grant-enforcement
cases are expected to FAIL against it. Those failures are true of this target:
an unauthenticated caller really does receive records. They are reported rather
than suppressed, because a suite that hid them would be worthless.
2. Its query base is `/sandbox/v1`, not `/v1`. RFC 9728 exists precisely so a
client can discover that, and this target publishes it in
`pdpp_core_query_base`. `queryBase` below records what the suite used.
No grant issuance or revocation endpoint exists, so cases needing a specific grant
shape report `skip` naming the missing hook rather than passing vacuously.
